findings.title: stack-prisma ships baking eql-3.0.6 while its pinned @cipherstash/eql runtime stays 3.0.5
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same release-ordering gap as F-05: eql is outside stack-prisma's fixed changeset group and the relaxed lockstep test passes, so stack-prisma could ship baking 3.0.6 against a pinned eql 3.0.5.

findings.title: A version-stamp-only release re-runs DROP SCHEMA eql_v3 CASCADE on existing databases
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new 3.0.6 edge reruns the full CASCADE reinstall on every existing database for a stamp-only change, and dependent indexes, policies and grants are not restored; the changeset confirms this.

findings.title: Temporarily widened lockstep marker and known-red live check outlive the release cycle
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The two-value marker and the known-red live check are a documented, time-boxed test-hygiene follow-up; forgetting it weakens a guard but carries no direct release risk.
